title: Affiliate and Referral Program Test Cases — Playwright + curl Companion
title_es: Casos de Prueba de Programa de Afiliados y Referidos — Companion Playwright + curl
description: Self-contained referral-flow fixture (link click, tracking cookie, signup, purchase, fraud check) plus a Playwright 1.48 spec covering attribution, self-referral blocking, and organic fallback — loads via file://, no server needed.
description_es: Fixture auto-contenido del flujo de referidos (clic en el enlace, cookie de tracking, registro, compra, control de fraude) más una spec de Playwright 1.48 que cubre atribución, bloqueo de autorreferencia y fallback orgánico — carga vía file://, sin servidor.
run: npm install && npx playwright test referral-flow.spec.ts
